facts.text: Through the Study-Service Term (SST), Goshen College students spend several weeks or more off campus living with a host family and participating in a service project.

sources.title: Anabaptist-Mennonite Studies Minor - Goshen College
sources.quote: Every Goshen College student can spend several weeks or more off campus through Study-Service Term (SST), studying language and culture, living with a host family, and joining a major service project, often abroad.
